author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm all for it.

english.text: I'm sorry I opened your mail by mistake.

jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3，ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 caak3 zo2 nei5 fung1 seon3。

english.text: LOVE Among a thousand lambs You are a golden sheep Among the rivers that gurgle, You are my living water. Among all the living flowers - You are the flower of others more beautiful. Among all my fairy tales You are the only one more truthful than others. Thousands of lights are burning, You are the fire in me burning. You are my sweetest poison. It struck me on the spot.

jyutping: oi3 hai2 jat1 cin1 zek3 joeng4 gou1 zung1，nei5 hai6 jat1 zek3 gam1 joeng4，hai2 saan4 saan4 ge3 ho4 lau4 zung1，nei5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 wut6 seoi2。 hai2 so2 jau5 wut6 faa1 zung1 - nei5 hai6 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 faa1 gang3 leng3。 hai2 ngo5 so2 jau5 ge3 tung4 waa6 gu3 si6 jap6 min6，nei5 hai6 wai4 jat1 jat1 go3 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 gang3 zan1 sat6 ge3 jan4。 gei2 cin1 zaan2 dang1 jin4 siu1 gan2，nei5 hai6 ngo5 jap6 min6 ge3 fo2 jin4 siu1 gan2。 nei5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 tim4 mat6 ge3 duk6 joek6。 dong1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 ging1 ngaa6。
text: 愛喺一千隻羊羔中，你係一隻金羊，喺潺潺嘅河流中，你係我嘅活水。 喺所有活花中 - 你係其他人嘅花更靚。 喺我所有嘅童話故事入面，你係唯一一個比其他人更真實嘅人。 幾千盞燈燃燒緊，你係我入面嘅火燃燒緊。 你係我最甜蜜嘅毒藥。 當我即刻驚訝。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Many of you like my mother because she is neotenic and has black hair and olive skin tinged with light yellow. She is duplicitous about her Baptist Protestant beliefs, and she does try to understand Buddhism, nevertheless. Born Roman Catholic in the Philippines, she was a genteel woman when she was younger, but in later years in North America, she has become more melancholy and harsh. In later years, she still finds it difficult to control her jealousy and anger.

jyutping: nei5 dei6 dong1 zung1 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 ngo5 aa3 maa1，jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 go3 jau3 tung4，jau5 hak1 sik1 ge3 tau4 faat3 tung4 jau5 cin2 wong4 sik1 ge3 gaam3 laam2 sik1 pei4 fu1，keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 zam3 seon3 wui2 san1 gaau3 seon3 joeng5 jau5 loeng5 min6 sing3，ji4 ce2 keoi5 kok3 sat6 soeng4 si3 lei5 gaai2 fat6 gaau3，bat1 gwo3，keoi5 hai2 fei1 leot6 ban1 ceot1 sai3 hai6 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 tou4，keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hai6 jat1 go3 jau1 ngaa5 ge3 neoi5 jan2，daan6 hai6 hai2 bak1 mei5 ge3 hau6 kei4，keoi5 jing4 jin4 bin3 dak1 gang3 gaa1 jau1 juk1 tung4 fan5 nou6。
text: 你哋當中有好多人鍾意我阿媽，因為佢係個幼童，有黑色嘅頭髮同有淺黃色嘅橄欖色皮膚，佢對佢嘅浸信會新教信仰有兩面性，而且佢確實嘗試理解佛教，不過，佢喺菲律賓出世係羅馬天主教徒，佢細個嗰陣係一個優雅嘅女人，但係喺北美嘅後期，佢仍然變得更加忧郁同憤怒。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "I think that Tim Hortons café and Starbucks café should have blueberry iced tea on their menu." "That's a refreshing idea! A blueberry iced tea would fit perfectly with the trend of fruit-infused teas that balance sweetness with a bit of tartness. Tim Hortons already has a strong iced tea base they could use, while Starbucks could easily fold it into their lineup of shaken iced teas and refreshers."

jyutping: 「ngo5 gok3 dak1 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 gun2 tung4 sing1 baa1 hak1 gaa3 fe1 gun2 ge3 caan1 paai2 jing1 goi1 jau5 laam4 mui2 bing1 caa4。」「ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 ling6 jan4 ji5 muk6 jat1 san1 ge3 zyu2 ji3！laam4 mui2 bing1 caa4 jyun4 cyun4 fu4 hap6 seoi2 gwo2 caa4 ge3 ciu4 lau4，ping4 hang4 tim4 mei6 tung4 siu2 siu2 syun1 mei6。Tim Hortons ji5 ging1 jau5 keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jung6 ge3 koeng4 lit6 bing1 caa4 gei1 dai2，ji4 sing1 baa1 hak1 ho2 ji5 hing1 sung1 gam2 zoeng1 keoi5 gaa1 jap6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 jiu4 bing1 caa4 tung4 caa4 dim2 hai6 lit6。」
text: 「我覺得 Tim Hortons 咖啡館同星巴克咖啡館嘅餐牌應該有藍莓冰茶。」「呢個係一個令人耳目一新嘅主意！藍莓冰茶完全符合水果茶嘅潮流，平衡甜味同少少酸味。Tim Hortons已經有佢哋可以用嘅強烈冰茶基底，而星巴克可以輕鬆噉將佢加入佢哋嘅搖冰茶同茶點系列。」
